contract_risks: K1: the strict json_schema's category uses type [string,null] with enum [...nine, null]; an enum containing null is outside OpenAI's documented strict subset (unmeasured offline). If rejected, every ON call is a BadRequestError -> today's 500 until rollback. Safer: anyOf [{type string, enum nine}, {type null}]; make the owner's step-1 structured-output smoke test a HARD flip precondition.

K2: a 1-based image_index reply on build 3's two-photo request keeps index 1 and DROPS index 2 -> exactly one product -> need_second_product on EVERY scan (a camera outage under the flag until rollback, refunded but unusable); limit 2 understates it. Alternative: keep out-of-range candidates unpaired (_image_index None) so a numbering slip degrades to V1 pairing.

K3: V2's no-invention rule raises the 'Unknown'/'Unknown Product' placeholder share vs V1; with V2 ON and ENABLE_RESULT_GATE OFF (R-A2 flips it sixth) those placeholders reach compare_from_text (MYEZ-002-class crowns or INSUFFICIENT_DATA -> the ON camera envelope). Add unknown_brand/unknown_name ints to the [VISION_V2] line and the canary; decide whether the V2 flip waits for B2.
K4: limit 3 (one photo with two products -> need_second_product) is a regression for any one-image API caller; Q2's keep-two-when-one-image alternative removes it cheaply.

K5: under ON the confidence VALUE default moves medium -> low in metadata.identified_products / need_second_product products (keys and types unchanged; build 3 does not render it) -- the one client-visible value change, flagged.

K6: wait_for cancels only our coroutine (OpenAI may still bill; SDK retries sit inside the one bound); the breaker records nothing on the cancellation (verified api_budget_service.py:995-1011) -- stated, fine.

K7 (R-A3 PASS): the new abstains reuse exits 1 and 2 (both refunds latched, no lifetime bump, no history row, no log_search row in either W4-13 state); the W4-13 ledger fixture carries identified_products by value so the public_vision_products copy is byte-identical.
K8: cache keys are not touched by this unit (the vision call is uncached; the orchestrator keys read search_query/full_name exactly as before).

K9 (envelope PASS): both new refusals are decided before compare_from_text, so neither becomes comparison_failed; the BadRequestError 500 lands on exit 1, which build 3 renders as the outage copy (#258), no retry loop.
